intro: The room ends in 680 CE. These two reports turn to Yemen in the present. Each is a dated account of part of a changing conflict.

reports.title: ‘We left everything behind’: 125,000 people displaced as war reignites in Yemen
reports.author: Nasser Al-Sakkaf
reports.focus: Families displaced around Taiz describe leaving home, finding shelter, and losing livelihoods.

reports.title: UN envoy meets Houthi negotiators in a bid to halt escalating violence in Yemen
reports.author: Samy Magdy and Ahmed Hatem
reports.focus: The UN envoy describes talks with Houthi negotiators and Yemen’s internationally recognized government amid renewed fighting.

claims.text: Zaydi and Twelver are different traditions within Shi'a Islam; Twelver Shi'ism is prominent in Iran. The modern Houthi movement grew from Yemen's Zaydi tradition in the 1990s. Zayd ibn Ali's uprising came in 740 CE, after this room's last date.
Not all Zaydi Muslims are Houthis.

context.closing: These older events do not explain Yemen's war on their own.

sources.title: A pragmatic view on Yemen’s Houthis
sources.author: Bruce Riedel

sources.title: World Directory of Minorities and Indigenous Peoples - Yemen: Zaydi Shias
sources.author: Minority Rights Group International
